items.title: 2 Large-Cap Stocks to Keep an Eye On and 1 Facing Headwinds
items.summary: Large-cap stocks have the power to shape entire industries thanks to their size and widespread influence. With such vast footprints, however, finding new areas for growth is much harder than for smaller, more agile players.

items.title: Lockheed Martin (LMT) Following Its PrSM Win Looks Undervalued On The Leading Narrative
items.summary: Lockheed Martin (LMT) just secured an indefinite delivery, indefinite quantity contract worth up to US$1.2b for Increment 2 of its Precision Strike Missile program. This development brings the system firmly into the production phase. For context, Lockheed Martin’s share price is at US$535.40, with a 90-day share price return of 6.3% and a 1-year total shareholder return of 14.33%. items.title: Lockheed Martin Fast-Tracks Secret Missile as Global Weapons Demand Rises
items.summary: Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) has unveiled the AIM-260 Joint Advanced Tactical Missile (JATM), a classified next-generation air-to-air weapon designed to provide greater range and effectiveness against advanced threats such as China’s J-20 fighter. items.title: Lockheed wins US Army missile contract worth up to $1.2 billion
items.summary: Sept 21 (Reuters) - Lockheed Martin said on Monday it had secured a contract worth up to $1.2 billion from the US Army to produce the Increment 2 variant of the Precision Strike Missile (PrSM).

items.title: Firefly Aerospace vs. Rocket Lab: Which Space Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: Firefly trades at a fraction of Rocket Lab's valuation multiple, but both face steep cash burn and profitability hurdles in 2026.

items.title: General Motors Boosts Defense Prospects With Lockheed Partnership
items.summary: GM's defense unit is supplying Lockheed Martin with Patriot missile components, adding to its growth prospects and potential military contracts.

items.title: GM delivers first PAC-3 components to Lockheed Martin
items.summary: General Motors’ defense subsidiary provided the components 22 days after it signed an agreement with the weapons maker.

items.title: Can Rising Ballistic Missile Demand Support Lockheed Martin's Growth?
items.summary: LMT is positioned to benefit from long-term ballistic missile modernization as Trident II upgrades support sustained strategic defense demand.
